title: Meakin 2013: regression of paraspinal / lumbar extensor mass at L3-L4_to_sacrum (F, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI T1 axial, 4 mm slices (9 mm effective spacing)
imaging.plane: axial slices approximately parallel to the L3/L4 disc, summed caudally
imaging.level_definition: volume caudal to the L3/L4 disc (L3/L4 to last caudal slice with extensor muscle)

quantity.name: regression
quantity.definition: regression equation(s) predicting a muscle-geometry quantity from anthropometry

source.authors: Meakin JR, Fulford J, Seymour R, Welsman JR, Knapp KM
source.sample: 42 women; female volunteers (5 with current back pain); age 50 (13) y, height 165 (7) cm, median mass 70 kg (IQR 18)

how_to_simulate: Evaluate the regression equation with the subject anthropometry (units as given in data).
Compare the model quantity (as defined for the predicted variable) with the predicted value +/- SE of prediction.

subject_model.source: Results text (mass = median); hL4S1 lordosis 30 (7) deg

data.note: R2 = 0.46 from text ("accounted for 46% of the variation"); minus sign on Age verified on the rendered page (lost in text layer)

predictor_units.hL4S1: deg (angle between superior endplates of L4 and S1)
